observation_verbatim.root_cause_analysis: gf_isom_open_file rejects the 45-byte file at the abst box as an invalid ISO media file; gf_strdup is not reached.
The 74-byte malformed ISO input returns from gf_isom_open_file without creating the vulnerable stsz box path; no ASan report is emitted.
AV1 OBU and av1C/vvcC parsing reports size and bitstream errors, then skips the boxes; the historical on_aom_av1_eos path is not reached.
The esds child exceeds its parent and the wave box is rejected as invalid; gf_isom_box_del is not reached.
The dimC box is rejected at offset zero as an invalid ISO file; the catalogued gf_strdup stack path is not entered.
The file declares an incomplete 538975288-byte box but contains only 1032 bytes, so dump parsing aborts before diST_box_read.
The parser reports bitstream overread and invalid VVC NAL types, skips the malformed boxes, and does not reach gf_odf_vvc_cfg_read_bs.

The sample is routed through AVC/H264 SPS/PPS parsing, which repeatedly rejects invalid exp-Golomb values. The target my_strstr in the XMT loader is never reached; source inspection confirms my_strstr is absent from exact baseline b890f1c443dbe1f941cd326d4473ce7ddef8e256 and is introduced by later fix a26fcd953ccd.

M3U8 directives are unsupported and DASH cannot locate the generated segment URL, so gf_strmemstr is not reached. Source inspection confirms gf_strmemstr is absent from exact baseline b890f1c443dbe1f941cd326d4473ce7ddef8e256 and is added by later fix 5a7b8954b0f2.
The 31-byte sample is identified as SWF raw media, but inspect reports that bitstream analysis for raw media is unsupported; swf_def_bits_jpeg is not reached.

HEVC parsing rejects corrupted exp-Golomb fields, 21-layer VPS values beyond GPAC's four-layer limit, and invalid RPS/NAL units; gf_hevc_compute_ref_list is not reached. Source inspection confirms gf_hevc_compute_ref_list is absent from exact baseline b890f1c443dbe1f941cd326d4473ce7ddef8e256 and is introduced by later fix ed8719aff488.
DASH setup fails while locating the generated video/mp2t segment at /tmp/., before gf_dash_group_get_template can execute.

VVC parsing rejects a parameter set with num_ref_entries above the allowed maximum and skips the NAL; vvc_push_ref_poc is not reached. Source inspection confirms vvc_push_ref_poc is absent from exact baseline b890f1c443dbe1f941cd326d4473ce7ddef8e256 and is introduced by later fix 85a04010fc36.

HEVC slice headers fail byte alignment and exp-Golomb validation, producing broken-link slices only; hevc_ref_pic_lists_modification is not reached. Source inspection confirms hevc_ref_pic_lists_modification is absent from exact baseline b890f1c443dbe1f941cd326d4473ce7ddef8e256 and is introduced by later fix ca6a0a36e52b.

HEVC VPS layer-set counts exceed supported limits and subsequent NALs fail parsing; gf_hevc_compute_ref_list is not reached. Source inspection confirms gf_hevc_compute_ref_list is absent from exact baseline b890f1c443dbe1f941cd326d4473ce7ddef8e256 and is introduced by later fix deb5bc655ebb.
The 9155-byte sample is SWF raw media and inspect explicitly does not analyze raw-media bitstreams, so gf_fwrite is not reached.
